gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-fenix: Fenix keeps its curves open, with strokes that stop short before turning inward, a text serif with an editorial lean. Fenix would hold up fine under Cowboys, though shrink the heading and its wide-spaced, laser-etched lines lose their authority.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-gentium-plus: Flat, single-weight linework with wide gaps between stems gives Cowboys its rustic, authoritative look. Gentium Plus follows with a refined serif whose c opens like a pitcher's mouth, so a long passage reads easily.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-habibi: Cowboys draws every letter with no shift between thick and thin, spaced well apart for a rustic, authoritative feel. And Habibi, a traditional serif with a clear channel leading into each round letter, does the quieter editorial work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-kay-pho-du: Cowboys traces every letter like a laser-etched line.  Kay Pho Du answers in a traditional text serif with counters that breathe, so the rustic heading and the classic body sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-labrada: Cowboys looks like bent paperclip wire, rustic and authoritative, with no swelling anywhere along its strokes. Labrada, a dignified text serif, feels bookish beside it.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-laila: Cowboys holds a single unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions, which gives headings a rustic, commanding presence. But Laila, a traditional text serif with generous space between curve ends and stem, is the one built for running text.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-montaga: Wide gaps between stems and a constant-width, laser-etched trace make Cowboys feel rustic and authoritative at a glance. Montaga's lifted curves read bookish.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-new-tegomin: Rustic and authoritative, Cowboys has the weight of a drawn wire, with generous gaps between each stem. And New Tegomin, a dignified, traditional serif whose c is a wide-open ring, gives the page a softer, more settled voice below it.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-podkova: Podkova reads bookish and traditional, its c opening broad and welcoming. Cowboys sits above it as a rustic wire-weight heading, and the two make a sturdy, authoritative page.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-rhodium-libre: Every stroke of Cowboys carries the same visual weight, with wide gaps between stems for a rustic, authoritative look. And Rhodium Libre, an editorial serif whose brush ends lift away before the curve closes, reads with a traditional rhythm over a longer stretch.
